title: Mind Reader Productivity Timer, Four Time Settings, 2 Volume Settings Tested
categoryName: Home & Garden:Kitchen, Dining & Bar:Kitchen Tools & Gadgets:Timers
descriptionText:
This Mind Reader Productivity Timer is the perfect addition to your kitchen or office. With four different time settings and two volume settings, it is versatile and easy to use. The sleek black design adds a touch of style to any workspace. 

The timer is made by the trusted brand Mind Reader and has been tested for accuracy and reliability. It is perfect for timing dishes, eggs, and other food items, as well as keeping track of your productivity. This timer is a must-have for anyone who wants to streamline their kitchen or office processes.
